game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must hold off crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Search Scout: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list. Then check found and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crypt seal from crypt crawlers in Echoing Courtyard: keep found above zero until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Search Scout
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 7, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
